versions.name: Insect Study
versions.description: Tell insects from spiders and millipedes, raise a caterpillar through metamorphosis, observe twenty species across four orders in the field, and study a bee hive or ant colony up close.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
